An operation was not supported.

This corresponds to POSIX errors `EADDRNOTAVAIL`, `EAFNOSUPPORT`, `ENODEV`, `ENOPROTOOPT`
`ENOSYS`, `EOPNOTSUPP`, `ERANGE`, `ESPIPE`, and `EXDEV`.
